steps.text: One Year Ago...
4:56 P.M. \ Overcast
Munitions Factory No. 11, Highbury District of Londinium

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Oi, has the last batch of polymer prep come in yet?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: What—what do you mean it hasn't?!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: This takes the piss...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Who was in charge of transporting those materials?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: It was, er, the one in charge, er...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What are you dithering for?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: ...It was Feist.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: That boy...

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: He went out first thing this morning. Should've been back ages ago.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Who went with him?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Tommy, Patto and Day.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: They're not the same workshop. How'd they get on the same shift?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: They all get along like a housefire. Keep mucking together all the time. Feist's their little ringleader.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You've hit a snag, from the sounds of it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Small potatoes, nothing more.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Small potatoes.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Catherine, you know what day it is today, right?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: How could I forget?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: `I've been fearing for my life I'll upset our officer if I sign and it looks like fowl scratch. I started practicing my signature ten whole days ago.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: That's practice under your belt, then. The General's stressing importance hard on the handover ceremony in two days. Reportedly, the Defense Forces' head is showing too.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Want a cig?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: ...Heh. Pass one here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You know why it is all your factory's people have stuck around until now, don't you?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We work very hard.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: That's a given.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You do your work very well. We're alike in that regard. Work, get paid, scrape a living.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: But our employers know all too well the more exceptional a merc's work, the less he can be trusted.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Standard fare.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Old manager of this industrial park, Sir Humphrey, never trusted us either. Before you dragged him away.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Don't make trouble for me, Catherine.
The mercenary's tone is placid, like he's the one asking Catherine if she wants a smoke. As he so often does.
This is his job. Offing a few disobedient Londinium workers to him is almost the same as the screws she tightens on the daily.
Catherine taps her cigarette into a bag. Can't have ash falling into the machinery.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've told you more times than I can count.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: If you want efficiency maintained, our factory can't afford one fewer worker.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I admire you a fair bit, Catherine. Even a typical merc might not even have the guts you do.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You've got the stuff. Thing is, it's possible to take anything too far.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Londinium's got over a hundred munitions factories just like yours. Even if this whole place was dead empty, the Regent wouldn't care.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Nothing will change. The ceremony will come the day after, we'll hand over everything promised, and all our workers will be there.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: No need for you lot to worry about a thing.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'll take your word for it, then.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Of course. Not got a lighter? You're just holding your cig there...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You hold onto it, after all. Londinium smokes always have a sort of engine oil to them. Can't ever get over it.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine, what do we do?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: (Pinches cigarette out)

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: ...Off to the loading area.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Patto! Done there?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Just this screw left!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sort it out. If this keeps up, they'll be waiting a whole week at least to get more polymer prep.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Polymer up to our ears, it's just batch after batch coming in. The hell are the Sarkaz building?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I haven't seen. Granny doesn't let me anywhere near the assembly line. Only her most trusted workmates get to climb up that walkway.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The longer this keeps up, the more it must be very important to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Gotta be a weapon, right? We've been pumping out auto-crossbows for the Sarkaz the last few days in the workshop.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Could only be. Still got so many ducal armies outside eyeing us.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Be ghastly letting the Sarkaz get away with this, I tell you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We've got to stop them, Patto. We can't be helping the Sarkaz fend off our own.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Think it'd be any use if we destroyed this batch of prep? Think we'd get sentenced?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll step up if that's what it comes to. I'm not afraid of being taken in.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You can't do that.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...Granny?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Grab 'em.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Patto—do it!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Eh—?
On the fly, she grabs a small file and throws it.
With a clang, the worker's spanner flies out of his hand and onto the ground.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Do you know what it is you're doing?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm stopping the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're making a scene.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've got it all planned! It won't drag any of you in. I'll tell the Sarkaz I did it, and then—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: —and then you'll die at the Sarkaz's hands. You're making yourself out as a hero, aren't you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll try and flee. I've been planning this forever—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're using the crawler you modified. You're hiding on the cargo track, and slipping out of Highbury that way.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: So you knew...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've been living in this industrial park for over fifty years. Whatever silly business you try, it won't slip by me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny, listen to me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I received some news. There's a rebel organization active in Sudean right now. They've rescued a whole number of people from the Sarkaz, and they've even taken back some plates!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They call themselves the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps—we're going to meet them!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Are you now?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: And then?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Er... what?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Are they lacking for smiths? Are you going to assemble and automate production pipelines for them, maybe design the next generation of crawlers?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You can't even put a single armament together. You're going to go up to the people at this Self-Salvation Corps and tell them you want to bash Sarkaz heads in with spanners?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm learning!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know the stories you've told me, like how you got selected to build steam armor when you were young, and I've heard you spending night after night polishing at power conduits.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I don't get it... We're Londinium workers, you've been teaching me that since I was little. You've told me how our factory built modern Victoria—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But now? We're lowering our flag at a handover ceremony, and raising the Sarkaz ensign.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And then? We're taking the assembly line we're so proud of and producing weapons for the Sarkaz with it, and those weapons will end up pointed at Victorians!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How can you bear life like this?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Like what?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Life like this is our life, the life you and your parents have always been living.

spans.text: our life, the life you and your parents have always been living.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Look at this factory.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Nobles with titles longer than their surnames, business tossers with lives built on trade, even the Sarkaz... we've had people posing as its master come and go.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But the assembly line's still there. The machines still haven't come to a halt. Each rivet that's passed through our hands is still in the place it's meant to be.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Whoever might be occupying that palace in the middle of Londinium, this city we built will still see tomorrow and the day after that.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I don't want a tomorrow like this!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What kind of life is a life without freedom? It's being alive at most, that's it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If this factory... if Londinium isn't ours any longer, then what was the point of everything we made for it?!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You know, Feist...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Twenty-five years ago, that night when the flames lit up the sky, your dad said much the same thing to me.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Boss, the Sarkaz are almost back—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're free to go wherever you want.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But from this moment on, you are forbidden from ever setting foot in the factory again, Feist.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: A worker who won't finish the job with his own hands isn't fit for the job.

spans.text: A worker who won't finish the job with his own hands

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Anyone who wants to go with him, I won't stop you either.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Just remember—you step out of this door, and you are no longer one of us.
